videos.title: El Muñeco Chimpayate / Noche de Espantos
videos.overview:
El Muñeco Chimpayate: A show business director (Edgar Vivar) is waiting for "El Gran Chori" (Rubén Aguirre), a puppet master which possess a doll that looks so real that raises some eyebrows

Noche de Espantos: When a young lady (Maria Antonieta de Las Nieves) finds herself alone in an old house, she calls for El Chapulín cause she's certain that there's some evil spirits lurking around

videos.title: El misterio del abominable hombre de las nieves
videos.overview: A pair of hikers discover an abandoned cabin and opt to spend the night there. Nevertheless, they harbor suspicions that the Abominable Snowman may be in close proximity.
